source.title: Journey To Moonglade
source.description:
I suggest you start in Moonglade, the Cenarion Circle stronghold. It was Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage that ordered the way shut, but not all of the druids agree with this. Some may be willing to assist you.

You are resourceful and I am confident you can overcome this obstacle. Gain access to the summit and speak to me again.
source.objective: Find a way to reach the summit of Mount Hyjal.
source.completion:
You want to travel to the world tree? My mother had recent dealings there... until she went missing. That's why I am here and want an audience with the Cenarion Circle's leadership. That is my concern, not yours, though.

The wards barring Hyjal aren't what they used to be. You can't go through them, you may be able to go over them. I know someone who may be willing to give you aid.
